type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (horizontal oval)
visual_en: Horizontal oval brownish-orange carnelian/agate engraved in naskh, 4 lines, set in a milgrain bezel inside a scalloped frame with side tabs; fan-ribbed openwork shoulders. warm yellow/rose gold-tone metal (looks like gold, clearly warmer than the silver rings shot the same evening). Good condition.
facts_en: Surat al-Ikhlas with basmala, legible: «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل هو الله احد الله الصمد لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفوا احد» (#426, #428). Hallmark #429: two oval stamps, one script, one figural; not legible.
notes_en: #429 (inside of shank, same rose-gold metal) shot right after the side view #428. #425/#427 are pixel-identical '(1)' copies.

type_en: men's ring with engraved agate (round-oval)

facts_en: Inscription only partly legible (words like «يا … كل … يا عفا…» ?), not read. Hallmark #434: three stamps (two oval script stamps and an irregular middle stamp), not legible.
notes_en: Different stone from g3-01 (round, 3-4 lines vs wide 4-line Ikhlas). Hallmark #434 follows side view #433.

type_en: men's ring with engraved agate in a lobed (cloud/cartouche) shape
visual_en: Lobed cartouche-shaped grey-brown agate engraved in nasta'liq with small floral fillers, in a matching lobed milgrain frame; fan-ribbed shoulders. warm yellow/rose gold-tone metal (looks like gold, clearly warmer than the silver rings shot the same evening).
facts_en: Nasta'liq inscription not read. Hallmark #439: «F» stamp between two oval script stamps.
notes_en: Distinctive stone shape; easy to recognise if re-shot elsewhere.
